name: Károly Sepsy
title: CBDO
bio: Károly is the CBDO at TC2, having previously worked as the company's CTO for six years. Originally a software developer, he has been working with AWS and Google Cloud technologies since 2012 in cloud architecture and consulting roles across Hungary and the United Kingdom. His expertise spans CI/CD, cloud migrations, data analytics, and AI platforms. In his current role, he focuses primarily on large-scale cloud transformation projects, managed services, and cloud strategy, while maintaining a strong interest in the evolving opportunities of generative AI.
